title: Structure à l'infini des Mg,ν [pages 1 à 90, dont table des matières] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

errors: No mathematical error. 'Orientation convenable' is loose wording: the hemi-dodecahedron is non-orientable (it tiles RP^2). What is really needed is a choice of one of the two A5-orbits of 6 pentagons in the Petersen graph, i.e. one of two hemi-dodecahedral face structures. The compatibility statement with G_I^+ but not S_I is exactly right for that choice.

The proposition only asserts an isomorphism of dual graphs. As a graph alone the Petersen graph already has full S5 symmetry; the A5 restriction arises only when the 2-cell (face) structure is included.

ideas.what: Boundary of M̄_{0,5} is a stable curve over Z: 10 P^1's, 15 nodes, arithmetic genus 6, maximally degenerate (all components 3-pointed P^1).
ideas.modern_name: Boundary stratification of M̄_{0,5}; the 10 (-1)-lines of the degree-5 del Pezzo surface
ideas.usually_credited_to: Classical (lines on dP5); Keel 1992 and Kapranov for M̄_{0,n} boundary structure
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme discusses M_{0,5} and its role in the Teichmüller tower, but not this explicit statement as far as I know

ideas.what: Dual graph of the boundary is the Petersen graph = 1-skeleton of the hemi-dodecahedron; dually, boundary components and points correspond to faces and edges of the hemi-icosahedron.
ideas.modern_name: Petersen graph as intersection graph of the 10 lines on dP5 / boundary complex of M̄_{0,5}
ideas.usually_credited_to: Folklore/classical; the boundary complex of M_{0,5} as Petersen graph is standard in tropical geometry, e.g. tropical M_{0,5}

ideas.what: The hemi-dodecahedral structure is preserved only by A5; odd permutations exchange the two hemi-dodecahedral structures (two A5-orbits of pentagons). A 'bi-icosahedron' is suggested to carry both.
ideas.modern_name: Two A5-orbits of 6 pentagons in the Petersen graph; link to the exotic transitive S5 ⊂ S6 / PGL_2(F_5)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Classical group theory/combinatorics (Sylvester's synthemes and totals; Coxeter on the Petersen graph and hemi-polyhedra)

missed.claim: Grothendieck treats the boundary of M̄_{0,5} as a genus-6 stable curve over Z with large symmetry. Numerically it lies in |-2K| of the quintic del Pezzo surface, so it is the special 'ten lines' member of the S5-invariant Wiman–Edge pencil, linked to icosahedral/dodecahedral geometry. His A5-vs-S5 remark parallels the fact that generic Wiman–Edge members have only A5 symmetry. This connection was made much later (Dolgachev–Farb–Looijenga) without reference to Grothendieck's lego viewpoint.
missed.quote: Le diviseur à l'infini du M^∞_{0,I} est une courbe stable déployée sur Spec Z, le graphe est isomorphe au 1-squelette du dodécaèdre gauche
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: Mostly historical. It shows Grothendieck viewing the boundary as a genus-6 stable curve with icosahedral structure, the same object studied in recent Wiman–Edge pencil work.

missed.claim: He asks for an intrinsic explanation, through hemi-icosahedral geometry or a 'bi-icosaèdre gauche', of why only G_I^+ respects the hemi-dodecahedral identification. The thread is left open on this page.
missed.quote: il faudrait le comprendre du pt de vue de la géométrie de l'icosaèdre gauche ... ça doit être lié bien sûr au bi-icosaèdre gauche (combinatoire)
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: The answer is essentially classical (the outer automorphism of S6 / PGL_2(F_5)). Its integration into the Galois action on the Teichmüller tower at the M_{0,5} level was not pursued in this form.

deep.surprise_reason: The Petersen-graph/hemi-dodecahedron description of the boundary of M̄_{0,5} and the A5/S5 subtlety are correct but essentially classical. Viewing the boundary as a genus-6 stable curve over Z is a nice touch foreshadowing the Wiman–Edge connection, but that is now in the literature.
transcription_corrections: 'dodécaèdre grand' / 'icosaèdre grand' / 'dodécaèdres grands' should almost certainly read 'gauche(s)' (skew = projective/hemi-polyhedron), consistent with 'icosaèdre gauche' on the previous page.
'courbe stable déployée' is plausible ('déployée' = split, added above the line).
'2-cuts[?]' is uncertain; it probably refers to the components meeting at points of order 3, i.e. each component has 3 special points.
Margin: likely 'NB M̂_{0,I} → M_{0,I} est un vrai schéma propre et lisse ... pour tous ... dès que M_{0,I} ≃ M_{0,ν}'.
'G_I^∨' is likely the full group S_I (vs G_I^+ = A_I).
